values: Materials and settings｜all fictional paper-and-pencil procurement document exercises
A fictional institution has 120 order lines awaiting spot checks; one requisition is for 20 units and, if the 4 units of inventory are allocable, 16 units are pending purchase.
A1: check the requisition purpose, specifications, quantity, and approval status; no order may be placed if it is not approved.

Task and output

description.text: Procurement clerks check purchase requisitions, inventory, quotes, orders, receipts, and invoice discrepancies. See the United States O*NET 43-3061 tasks, 2025 wage percentiles, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, the Chinese wage evidence gap, and the fictional entry exercises.

subject.name: Procurement clerks
subject.summary: Procurement clerks prepare purchase orders from approved requisitions, check supplier quotes, quantities, delivery dates, and inventory, follow up on delivery and invoice discrepancies, and keep traceable procurement records. The position is responsible for accurate routing and anomaly escalation and does not approve suppliers, prices, or payments on its own.
